I am an Applied Mathematics and Statistics graduate from Khalifa University with two years across data science, data engineering, analytics, and full stack development. At Saal.ai I was the primary developer of a procurement audit platform that reads ERP data and flags exceptions, and I worked on ETL pipelines, NLP-based matching, and dashboards.

Since April 2026 I have freelanced as a full stack developer for Join Future in Bahrain, where I am the main contributor to HiSalon, a salon management SaaS built on NestJS, PostgreSQL, React, and Flutter. Outside work I built and shipped Stmnt, an iOS app that turns bank statement PDFs into spending analysis. The work I want pairs modelling with the engineering that makes a model usable.
